name: spotify-launcher
local_adaptations: Use the native at-spi2-core dependency and declare CA certificates, CMake and pkgconf.
Keep Cargo caches/output inside the recipe; fetch locked inputs in prepare and build/test frozen.
Retain mandatory Spotify runtime libraries, source signatures, verification keyring, config, icons and licensing.
known_failure: Isolated root provisioning failed with FileConflicts on usr/lib/libcurl.la, shipped by both the curl and libcurl-gnutls archives because the curl recipe lacked makepkg's default !libtool cleanup. Corrected in curl 8.23.0-2; no spotify-launcher recipe change is needed. Publish the rebuilt curl, libcurl-compat and libcurl-gnutls archives, refresh the worker repository, and retry in a fresh isolated root.
